name: Sample-data demonstration   /   September 2026
text: Sample-data demonstration   /   September 2026

Welcome. This walkthrough follows asset information, portal submissions, approval, network planning, simulation, decision review, publication and operational reconciliation. Allow 45 minutes, including discussion. The screens contain sample data from the demonstration environment. Dates and records vary between examples. The outage case is a saved example, not a newly executed operational instruction.

Demonstration guidance: Screenshots are sample application states. Use approved trial data for live input and publication.

Domain approval and planner approval serve different purposes. A portal approver validates the input. The dispatch planner decides how the combined network should operate. Publication is the explicit handoff to the operating records. The demonstration account is a management account, so individual operator screens may expose fewer controls. Source: BRD pp. 1–3; PRD pp. 1–4; Product Profile pp. 1–3.
